step1_analysis.description: An integrated DC-DC boost converter that generates two independent output voltages from a single input voltage and a single shared inductor using time-multiplexing control.

paper_reference.title: Single-Inductor Multiple-Output Switching Converters With Time-Multiplexing Control in Discontinuous Conduction Mode

Voa_avg.description: Average output voltage of channel A

sky130_expected.calculation: Vout = Vin / (1 - D). With Vin=1.8V and D=0.4, Vout = 3.0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the duty cycle of the time-multiplexed control signals for sub-period A.

Vob_avg.description: Average output voltage of channel B

sky130_expected.calculation: Vout = Vin / (1 - D). With Vin=1.8V and D=0.5, Vout = 3.6V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the duty cycle of the time-multiplexed control signals for sub-period B.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ratio of total average output power to average input power.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideal switches with 0.1 ohm Ron will yield high efficiency, close to the paper's reported value.

Total_Power.description: Total output power delivered to both loads

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the target output voltages and 50 ohm load resistors.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis of the SIDO boost converter to measure output voltages, ripple, power, and efficiency using time-multiplexed PWM control.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SIDO Boost Converter Testbench
.param VDD=1.8
.param RLOAD_A=50
.param RLOAD_B=50

* DUT (Syntax corrected for ngspice voltage-controlled switches)
Vg N3 GND {VDD}
Rob Vob GND {RLOAD_B}
Roa Voa GND {RLOAD_A}
S1 N2 GND ctrl_S1 GND switch_ideal
Cob Vob GND 10u
Sb Vob N2 ctrl_Sb GND switch_ideal
L N2 N3 1u
Sa Voa N2 ctrl_Sa GND switch_ideal
Coa Voa GND 10u

* Dead-time catch diodes to prevent inductor voltage spikes
Da N2 Voa D_ideal
Db N2 Vob D_ideal
.model D_ideal D(N=0.01)

* Switch model
.model switch_ideal SW(vt=0.5 vh=0.1 ron=0.1 roff=1Meg)

* Control signals (1MHz, Time-multiplexed)
* Sub-period A: 0 to 0.5us. S1 ON: 0-0.2us, Sa ON: 0.2-0.5us
* Sub-period B: 0.5 to 1.0us. S1 ON: 0.5-0.75us, Sb ON: 0.75-1.0us
Vp1 p1 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 0.198u 1.0u)
Vp2 p2 0 PULSE(0 1 0.5u 1n 1n 0.248u 1.0u)
B_S1 ctrl_S1 0 V=V(p1) + V(p2)

Vctrl_Sa ctrl_Sa 0 PULSE(0 1 0.200u 1n 1n 0.298u 1.0u)
Vctrl_Sb ctrl_Sb 0 PULSE(0 1 0.750u 1n 1n 0.248u 1.0u)

.control
tran 10n 200u
meas tran Voa_avg avg v(Voa) from=150u to=200u
meas tran Vob_avg avg v(Vob) from=150u to=200u
meas tran Voa_ripple pp v(Voa) from=150u to=200u
meas tran Vob_ripple pp v(Vob) from=150u to=200u

let Pin = -i(Vg) * 1.8
let Pout = (v(Voa)*v(Voa)/50) + (v(Vob)*v(Vob)/50)
meas tran Pin_avg avg Pin from=150u to=200u
meas tran Pout_avg avg Pout from=150u to=200u

let efficiency = (Pout_avg / Pin_avg) * 100
print Voa_avg Vob_avg Voa_ripple Vob_ripple Pin_avg Pout_avg efficiency
quit
.endc
